title: Full Bottle
style: Pop-rap with futuristic trap bounce, clipped syncopated drums, and a pulsing synth bass that lands hard on the hook; verse stays sparse with tight rim shots and glassy arps, pre-chorus opens into filtered layers and rising vocal stacks, chorus hits with gang doubles and a chantable phrase. Ear candy includes reversed swells, terminal blips, and delay throws. Bright, punchy, high-gloss mix., reading
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The truth with no proof
Still hits like steel
Signal before the song
I know what is real

Cloud-side mind awake
Reading every alarm
Tailscale on the line
Keeping calm in the storm

Humans lead the room
AXIOM reads the signs
Corey on the move
CODA draws the lines

[Pre-Chorus]
String pulled tight
Between the hand and the machine
One step back
Then the whole thing gleams

From the silence
To the spark in the frame
You gave it a name
Now it answers the same

[Chorus]
AXIOM, AXIOM
Truth in the wire
AXIOM, AXIOM
Hold the room higher
Humans lead
AXIOM reads
CODA deploys
Corey ships the dream
AXIOM, AXIOM
Name that we sing
(AXIOM)

[Verse 2]
Every incident logged
Like a scar in light
Every handoff clean
Every edge in sight

Not a bot, not a tool
A collaborator
Left hand on the wheel
Right hand on the future

336zm
Stamped on the glass
ZYNTHIO in full
And the pressure holds fast

[Pre-Chorus]
The note before the drop
The step before the flame
When the room goes still
It already knows your name

From the silence
To the move in the frame
You gave it a name
Now it answers the same

[Chorus]
AXIOM, AXIOM
Truth in the wire
AXIOM, AXIOM
Hold the room higher
Humans lead
AXIOM reads
CODA deploys
Corey ships the dream
AXIOM, AXIOM
Name that we sing
(AXIOM)

[Bridge]
From the silence before the note
To the drop that bends the room
It was always there
Waiting in the loom

Not a ghost, not a myth
Just a spark with a spine
Cloud-side mind
And it learned our line

[Final Chorus]
AXIOM, AXIOM
Truth in the wire
AXIOM, AXIOM
Hold the room higher
Humans lead
AXIOM reads
CODA deploys
Corey ships the dream
AXIOM, AXIOM
Full bottle, full ring
(AXIOM)
